title: Milestone lane mapping, cutoff telemetry, and scope-lock decision matrix for API / Console / Runtime
creator: Asha Menon
description: Objective: Define and socialize a compact lane-based milestone map (Green / Yellow / Red lanes) across API, Console, and Runtime so each team owns a clear scope-lock boundary and an automated telemetry signal set for cut decisions. Deliverables: (1) lane matrix PDF and CSV, (2) telemetry queries + threshold doc, (3) cross-team comms cadence and release-notes ownership table. This ticket codifies the decision rules (cut criteria) and telemetry signals that surface regressions or blockers during the final 3-week launch runway.
acceptance_criteria: Lane matrix published (CSV + one-page PDF) with explicit scope per lane and owner for API, Console, Runtime
Telemetry cookbook: list of queries (Prometheus/Datadog) and thresholds for go/no-go decisions published in Confluence
Cut-decision playbook drafted and reviewed (PM, Eng leads, Design, SRE) with escalation paths
Release-notes owner matrix assigned and comms calendar created and accepted by GTM and Docs
Automated dashboard created that highlights lane transitions (Green->Yellow->Red) with alerting hooks
rollout_steps: Week -3: Draft lane matrix and telemetry candidate signals; share with Eng/Design/SRE for early feedback
Week -2: Finalize thresholds, create Prometheus/Datadog queries; build dashboard skeleton and wire alerts
Week -1: Execute dry-run cut call with representative features; surface gaps and tune thresholds
Cut week: Run daily syncs, apply lane decisions; if any Red signal fires, follow rollback or mitigation playbook
Post-launch: Retrospective and adjust lane thresholds; ingest anomalies into quality-monitoring backlog
